title: 1889 Kumamoto earthquake
summary: The English Wikipedia article "1889 Kumamoto earthquake", at revision 1367327398, opens: "The 1889 Kumamoto earthquake occurred at 23:40 JST on 28 July in the western part of Kumamoto, Japan. It was also called the Kinpozan earthquake and its magnitude was 6.3." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q4556361, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "Earthquake in Japam". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
